what: The source of SkinTone34's face (Phase25 25.3): an image model's picture of the subject's head island, turned into melanin and blood on the skin maker's model (tools/converters/fit/project_face.py, then gen_skin_maps.py --subject Tone34 --pigments). The ear is the maker's gradient, not the picture's.
picture_pixels_sha256_is: sha256 of the RGB array's bytes (rows top to bottom, 8 bits a channel): a regeneration is checked by pixels, since a PNG encoder may write the same pixels as different bytes

model.name: Krea 2 Turbo (krea/Krea-2), the Comfy-Org ComfyUI repack in FP8
model.outputs: owned by whoever generates them; Krea claims no ownership (the licence's section 5.3), so the picture is dedicated CC0 here
model.conditions_met_when_made: commercial use under the licence's revenue limit (the maintainer's ruling RD-AIS-1, 2026-11-01); AI origin disclosed by this record and the provenance row's made: ai-assisted; no content filter needed for a face; whether the model writes a watermark is unverified (F-AIS-3)

generation.runner: ComfyUI 0.43.2, over its API (project_face.py paint; standard library only)
generation.source_island: project_face.py source, from C (the maker's own Tone34 map, no outside field)
generation.regenerated: 2026-11-02: pixel-identical to the picture first made on 2026-11-01 (Phase25 25.3.1)

chain: uv run --with scipy tools/converters/fit/project_face.py ears <dir> first_<stem>.png
uv run --with scipy tools/converters/fit/project_face.py field <dir> <picture> --ears ears_<stem>.json
uv run --with scipy tools/converters/fit/paint_uv.py put <dir> face_<stem>.png <tag>
